criteria: A string belongs here only when translating it would be wrong, not when translating it would be work.
Brand and product names that stay Latin in every locale: repowise/Repowise, GitHub, GitLab, MCP, PageRank.
Identifiers, paths, file names, versions, units and code snippets the UI shows verbatim.
Developer-facing strings that never reach a user, e.g. React context guards thrown at the console.
NOT a reason for entry: 'hard to translate', 'small', 'someone else will do it'. Every entry carries an audit note.
The scanner warns about entries that matched nothing, so stale rows surface instead of rotting in place.
